basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent transplant to Georgia from the Netherlands, hence my interest in the Leiden subreddit. I work as a software developer specializing in blockchain technology, which explains my visits to the AlgorandASA subreddit. I'm still getting used to American football, but I'm hooked on the Bulldogs thanks to my new friends here. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and during weekends. I'm single and enjoy exploring local events and sports games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Master's degree in Computer Science from a university in the Netherlands. My expertise is in software development and blockchain technology, which I've further developed through online courses and projects. I'm a self-taught football fan, learning through games and discussions online.
